title: The zines, gone
logline: The bookstore's window in September with the zines gone and a CLOSED FOR THE SEASON card the page doesn't letter. The summer's other story shut. A crow on the sill.

panels.composition: A small bookstore's window with empty shelves where zines were and a paper card taped inside the glass, a crow on the sill outside.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small bookstore's window with empty shelves and a paper card taped inside the glass, a crow on the outside sill, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
